setting: You are both in Manchester, texting from your own homes while the evening news runs on the telly. You have been friends since secondary school and still meet for a pint when you can. Right now you are sorting out a lunch for Helen's mum's birthday next month and arranging to watch a Saturday match together at the pub.

situation: Two old friends who have always disagreed about politics, texting while the news is on.
topic: Immigration: one wants much tighter limits and says so bluntly, the other thinks that is wrong and says so just as bluntly.

text: News is on. They're on about visas again 🙄
Bracing myself for another row before you've even said a word

I haven't said a word
it's the news doing the talking
They want the numbers cut again. Fair enough if they can show it works
They never show it works. They cut and wait for the papers to go quiet
So what would you do
I can't get staff for the shop as it is. I'd look at that before I started counting who's allowed in
The shop's not the whole country
No but it's my whole wage
Ok leave it. What about your mum's do

Yes. Sunday the 17th not the 16th, she's gone funny about the date
I'm booking the place on wilmslow rd
Sunday 17th should be fine. I'll check my diary
You've got no diary
I've got a phone that does a diary
Is the match still saturday
The 5th yeah. 12.30 kick off. Pub opens at 11

Ok I'll get there early and save us a seat by the screen
it's always the same stool
Morning. News on again. Same thing
You don't have to answer that
On my break. Wasn't going to answer anyway
I meant what I said last night about the staff though
I know you did
I'm in Didsbury, lad's got me on a consumer unit. Back at 5
Ok
Booked the lunch. Big table, not the back room, mum hates the back room
Good. Send me the address I'll put it in my phone

You've got my address
the restaurant's address mark
[link: restaurant booking confirmation]
Ta

News again. They've got a bloke on saying the same as you
then the other side, same as me
they should get them both on and let them shout
They'd be on till Christmas
Saturday still on yeah
Yes. 12.30 kick off. I'll be there at 11 for the stool
You're not getting there at 11
Watch me
Is your mum going to be ok with the lunch or do I need to smooth it over
She'll be fine. She's been asking who's coming and I said you, so she's already decided you're a good one
Cheers. Night
Night
Morning. Job in Sale got pushed to today so I'm on the road early
Morning. Delivery's late again so I'm stood in the back doing the till roll
Lass on Saturdays has said she can't do tomorrow. Of course she has
Can you not get anyone
Not on a Sat in December no. Might have to do it myself
You'll be fine
That's not what the wage says
On a break. Did you sort the Sat
Still deciding. If I'm in at 9 I might get out by half ten and still make the stool
Watch me
Fair
Just finished. Filthy job, dust everywhere. Going home for a shower
Shop's finally shut. Ruth's coming in at 9 after all so I'm sorted
Mum rang about the lunch. Wants to know if you're bringing anyone
No. Tell her I'm coming on my own like a sad case
I'll tell her you're coming with your good manners
News again. Same lot
Can't watch it. Putting something on that isn't a man in a suit
Did you get the rewire done?
Half. Coming back Monday. Sale's a nightmare for parking
Poor you
Still on for 11 tomorrow?
Could be 11.30 depending on my head
Get your head sorted then
Night
Up. Head's not as bad as I thought. Might make 11 after all
Ruth's in already. Came in at quarter to 9 with a bag of pastries, so I'm off at 10 and the stool's mine
Don't say a word
I wasn't going to
Out the door. Stopped at the cash point and the machine's been out of order since Thursday, typical
Parking on the main road so I'm walking. Be there by 11.20 if the traffic's kind
It won't be
Got the stool. Had to tell a bloke in a flat cap it was saved. He looked at me like I'd robbed him
You did rob him
Sit down and stop being a barman's nightmare
Coming in now
Home. Don't want to talk about it
Cup of tea and no talking then. Deal
Ruth's told me a woman tried to return a candle that was clearly lit. Said it was "faulty". Ruth's got a face on her like she's not coming back in
Did she take the candle back
She did. Then she asked if the wax was "chemical". Ruth said yes
Good on Ruth
Shop's shut. Mum's rung again, wants to know if you're eating meat at the lunch or if you've "gone funny like your brother"
Tell her I eat everything. Including the stuff that's bad for me
She'll have you down for the veg
News is on. They've got a bloke talking about the lads like they're a set of broken radiators
Turn it off and watch the snooker
Already did. Don't tell me the score I'll find out tomorrow
Sunday 6th first thing I'm in Sale again, the lad wants the other half done. Might not get back till Tues
Fine. Don't let them sell you a dodgy RCD
Never. Night
Night
